about_the_game:
A point-and-click adventure about memory and escape.

Perfect for fans of point-and-click puzzle or escape-room games, and for explorers who enjoy pixel art, atmosphere, and environmental storytelling.

Story

Soul of Recollection is a pixel-style point-and-click adventure game. On a quiet yet unfamiliar night, you awaken in a classroom, stripped of all memories. Every locked door and scattered object hides a clue. You must solve puzzles and explore step by step to piece together the truth and find a way out of the school shrouded in darkness.

However, along the way, you encounter another trapped girl. She seems to know a lot, yet her memory is in disarray. Even stranger—after meeting her, the student ID card that once bore your photo suddenly shows her name and information...

Who are you? Who is she? What secrets lie hidden within this school and these memories?

Features

  • Immersive Point-and-Click Experience
    Interact with scenes through intuitive pointing and clicking. Collect items, solve puzzles, and push the story forward.

  • Pixel Art with a Mysterious Atmosphere
    All scenes are inspired by real-life schools and reconstructed with detailed pixel art. Beneath the nostalgic visuals, the nighttime campus exudes an eerie familiarity.

  • Multiple Rooms and Puzzle Designs
    From classrooms to halls, cafeterias to gyms, laboratories to auditoriums—each area introduces new mechanisms and challenges. Estimated full playtime: 4–8 hours.

  • Dual-Identity Mystery Story
    Crossing memories and shifting dual perspectives unravel the deeper truth behind the puzzles.

  • Concise yet Profound Narrative
    With around 2,000 words of core text, the story delivers immersion through minimal prose, rich environments, and fragmented clues.

  • Atmospheric Suspense, Not Horror
    No jump scares or gore—focuses on mood, discovery, and puzzle flow.

  • Built-in Hints and Solutions
    Every puzzle includes optional hints and answers. No need to fear getting stuck—enjoy the story seamlessly.

Feedback

Dear player,

I’m Orange, the solo developer of this game. It took two years from concept to completion, and I’m truly happy to finally share it with you on Steam!

If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or other issues, please report them via Steam support with a short description of the problem and the scene or steps where it occurred. This helps me locate and fix it faster.

I’ll do my best to resolve issues as soon as possible. Thank you so much for your patience and support!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 64-bit or compatible distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5 / Vulkan 1.0 compatible GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon RX 460 / Intel UHD 630 or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon (Rosetta 2 supported)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible GPU (OpenGL 4.5 equivalent, Apple M1 or Intel Iris Plus 655 and above)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later

  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5 / Vulkan 1.0 compatible GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon RX 460 / Intel UHD Graphics 630 or better)

  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: Soul of Recollection is a pixel-style point-and-click puzzle game. Explore a quiet school at night, collect items, solve puzzles, and piece together lost memories to find your way out. With no horror elements, it blends light storytelling and immersive mystery.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean
